name: Create a flag

context:
PUT /v1/projects/{projectIdOrName}/feature-flags/flags
Create a new feature flag for a project. The flag must have a unique slug within the project and specify its kind (boolean, string, number, or json).
Required: projectIdOrName (path) — The project id or name
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: List flags
description: List flags Retrieve feature flags for a project. GET /v1/projects/{projectIdOrName}/feature-flags/flags
context:
GET /v1/projects/{projectIdOrName}/feature-flags/flags
Retrieve feature flags for a project. The list can be filtered by state and supports pagination.
Required: projectIdOrName (path) — The project id or name
Optional: state (query) — The state of the flags to retrieve. Defaults to `active`.; withMetadata (query) — Deprecated. Whether to include creator metadata in each flag in the response. Resolve creator identity client-side (e.g. via the team members endpoint) instead; this parameter will be removed in a future release. Use `GET /v1/projects/:id/feature-flags/flags/:flagIdOrSlug?withMetadata=true` for single-flag lookups that need creator metadata.; limit (query) — Maximum number of flags to return. When not set, all flags are returned.; cursor (query) — Pagination cursor to continue from.; search (query) — Search flags by their slug or description. Case-insensitive.; tags (query) — Filter flags by tag. Repeat the parameter for multiple tags (all must match).; teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: List flags
description: List flags Retrieve feature flags for a project. GET /v2/projects/{projectIdOrName}/feature-flags/flags
context:
GET /v2/projects/{projectIdOrName}/feature-flags/flags
Retrieve feature flags for a project. Returns an opaque cursor for pagination.
Required: projectIdOrName (path) — The project id or name
Optional: state (query) — The state of the flags to retrieve. Defaults to `active`.; limit (query) — Maximum number of flags to return.; cursor (query) — Pagination cursor to continue from.; search (query) — Search flags by their slug or description. Case-insensitive.; tags (query) — Filter flags by tag. Repeat the parameter for multiple tags (all must match).; createdBy (query) — Filter flags by the id of the entity that created them (a user or team id).; maintainerIds (query) — Filter flags by maintainer user id. Repeat the parameter for multiple maintainers (any may match).; includeMarketplaceFlags (query) — Whether to include Marketplace experimentation items in the paginated response. Defaults to false.; teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.
